maddeler.e:
ينتهبون (form VIII)
# يَنْتَهِبُونَ (yantahibūna) /jan.ta.hi.buː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِنْتَهَبَ (intahaba)
# يُنْتَهَبُونَ (yuntahabūna) /jun.ta.ha.buː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِنْتَهَبَ (intahaba)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
